gemma2:9b.title: Fat Man in a Middle Seat: Forty Years of Covering Politics
gemma2:9b.explanation: A candid and humorous memoir by the author, reflecting on four decades of political reporting and the unique experiences that shaped his career in journalism. This biography offers insights into the world of politics and the challenges faced by those who cover it.
